reviewer: primary Codex visual inspection using original-resolution stills

answers.reason: The actor has a basketball silhouette, orange pebbled surface and three dark seams; every target has a bottle body, shoulder, neck, cap and label.
The 0.24 m diameter ball and 0.28 m bottles read as plausible real-world proportions.
Blue low, orange medium and green high internal columns have distinct visible top heights; labels are separate bands and do not encode the fill.
Setup, sharp impact and aftermath show continuous contact propagation with three different response frames, not a simultaneous arranged lean.
Measured impact adds directional speed blur while the ball seams, bottle silhouettes, caps, label bands and contact direction remain legible.
The aftermath has solver-discovered radial separation and differing rotations rather than a neat hand-placed composition.
Native refraction, internal colored liquid, cap highlights, pebbled ball material and contact shadows are materially more credible than PC8 abstract wooden targets.

claimCeiling: Readable metric physical archetypes and solver-owned contact pass; advertising-grade glass, liquid slosh, deformation and photorealism remain unproven.
